function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

function.name: calculate_discounted_cash_flow
function.description: Calculate the discounted cash flow of a bond for a given annual coupon payment, time frame and discount rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

coupon_payment.description: The annual coupon payment. This is a float type value.

period.description: The time frame in years for which coupon payment is made.

discount_rate.description: The discount rate. This is a float type value.

face_value.description: The face value of the bond, default is $1000.

message.reasoning:
The user wants calculation of heat capacity at constant pressure (Cp) for air at T=298 K, V=10 m³. They didn't specify units or method; we can use ideal gas approximation Cp ≈ 29 J/(mol·K). But need amount of substance from PV=nRT. Use R=8.314 J/mol/K. For P? Not specified but "constant pressure" maybe standard atmospheric ~101325 Pa. So n=P*V/(R*T). Then Cp_total = n * cp_molar. Compute.

Let's compute:

P=1 atm=101325 Pa. V=10 m³. T=298 K. R=8.314 J/mol/K.

n = P*V / (R*T) = 101325*10 /(8.314*298).

Compute denominator: 8.314*298≈2477.772. Numerator: 1,013,250. Divide: 1,013,250/2,477.77 ≈409 mol approx? Let's do precise: 1,013,250 ÷ 2,477.772 = 408.9 mol.

Now Cp per mole for dry air about 29.1 J/(mol*K). Multiply: 408.9*29.1 ≈11900 J/K (~11.9 kJ/K). Actually 408.9*30 would be 12267 so slightly less: 408.9*29.1 = 11899 J/K.

Thus answer: around 12 kJ/K.

We should mention assumptions: ideal gas, standard pressure etc. Provide formula steps. Also note if they want specific heat capacity per unit mass: divide by mass. Mass m = n*M where M~28.97 g/mol -> convert to kg: 408.9*0.02897=11.86 kg. Specific Cp_specific = total/Cp_mass? Wait specific heat capacity c_p = Cp/mass = 11899 J/K divided by 11.86 kg = 1005 J/kg/K. That matches known specific heat of air ~1005 J/kg/K.

So provide both values.
